Me too. Lets play it at 9

||I did not live as I should have. My lady would have me work the land and protect my neighbor. I should have lived a life of merriment to spread joy to others who grieve. But I am not that man, nor will I live to be him. So I will fight. But should you read this that I fell, do not grieve for me. Do not grieve the man who would harm others to restore his own grievance. Do not grieve the fool who would give you a false hope. Shed no tears for old and weary for he has chosen to walk this road.

But I will not fight for simply death. I do not love my axe for that which falls. I do not love the struggle to curry glory or honor. I do not love the pain that torments my waking and dreaming thoughts. But should I fall, carry on.||

||carry on for the markets and the new lands. Carry on for the simple pleasures of life and kinship of others. I do not fight for myself, but for the smiles of many others that I never had the heart to have. I fight that others may carry in without the fear that I have carried under a black sun and centuries. I fight for love, I fight for freedom, I fight for chauntea. I am your shield, and the joy of a shield is to be beaten and broken to protect the bearer.||

||Sandigill, never doubt your wisdom, and let your good heart lead yourself and others to greatness.

Kiln, wherever you find yourself, i pray that you find what you seek and that many more lives will be touched.

Cato, you fight as I do, to protect that which you love. Never let your determination waver.

Vee, I must apologise. I wanted to use you to try and further my own goals with the gods, had we made it to the island I would likely have tricked you into bleeding for my efforts. Let your divine glow never go out, and that you have memories to last the ages.

Wynne, I know I have been harsh at times. I have faith in your virtue, but a proper shield cannot withstand doubting itself. When you protect others, you must preserve yourself.

Florian, you have been a light I have not had since that of my lady. You have driven me to surpass many obstacles. I cannot repay the debts I owe you except to give you the hope you have given me.

Leaf, melora is with you. You have never strayed from the purest of intentions. You have great faith in others and help heal even the deepest wounds with your presence. I plea that when I am gone you do not let that taint your light. You have given me more joy knowing that faith still empowers us in righteousness.

To all of those venturing to the new world: a new dawn will rise with or without me. The stars will still shine. Do not miss me.||

||Actura, you have carried the sins of your heritage for too long. You have love and support to make the future you decide. You have seen a fraction of the pain I've suffered, let it die with me and move towards a brighter dawn.||

My time was short, quick, and fun.
The lives of all, absolve to one.
One chance we have, to end a blight.
Do not grieve, if I die tonight

A fez you wear, a proud head piece.
One that most, would just release.
My brothers and sisters, Masons of all.
Tonight I fight, and I'll stand tall

I do not fear, the possible chance.
Of playing with death, and losing the dance.
I battle in hope, of a brighter day.
One that most, attempted to sway.

For this may be, my final say.
Alas, fear not, enjoy the day.
I fight for you, Master Daysong.
I hope you know, I meant no wrong.

A mason devout, I wish to be.
Keep your lanterns lit, and pray for me.
Do not weep, do not cry.
Farewell, my friends, no... Family....goodbye.
-Threebee U.C.

||1 bottle of Kyrzins Ooze 
Various hard candies
The pick she used for her mandolin||

<@!403783497564684291> , 
 ||   Please don’t be mad at me. I wanted so much to build a new life and to protect you the way you protected me our whole lives. You are strong and I want you to please turn to others when you need help, I know when things go bad you push people away. Please reach out. Please don’t force yourself into isolation. I love you so much, and I am sorry for leaving you so soon, but you are not alone. Let Andy know I am sorry, I don’t know what will happen to him if I die. Tell him he needs to watch out for you. He knows you better than I do. ||

<@!436232470242000916> ,
||I’m sorry about everything. I do not regret my actions, but I regret any harm I have caused you. Please turn to your friends, they will protect you. I love you and I want you to find happiness in the new world. Don’t let this destroy you, keep fighting, for me. I wish I had more words to describe my feelings but right now I am at a loss. Find your joy and find love in the people around you. I have joined Rah earlier than expected, but we will be waiting for you, please make me wait a long time. ||

<@!237577351532249110> ,
||I thank you friend for all you have done for me. And I thank you for wanting to take care of my family. Please watch over Lia, she will try to push everyone away, don’t let her. I am sorry I cannot help you build the oasis, I hope it is just as beautiful as you described. Please know I am grateful to have known you and to have received your kindness. I have attached the campaign song and a speech I wanted to give for your mayoral race. Please use it, build community, take care and build your school. ||

<@!594008151779573762> ,
||I will miss our conversations, but I am happy to know that you will still be able to share your voice with others. You care a lot about others and I want you to keep fighting for people. Don’t let others be alone just like you’ve never let me be alone. Thank you, friend. ||

<@!260820438026813440> ,
|| You saved my life and for that I owe you everything. From the moment we met you always had a smile and you always cared for me. I will miss you, all your spiders and all your little gifts. For a while I was trapped, by fear and threats and lies, you helped set me free. Thank you for allowing me to do this last thing by my own choice. I’m sorry that I broke your promise, I really tried not too.||

@everyone,
    || I am sorry that I couldn’t succeed.  Please stay together and fight together. Don’t push each other away. Leaf please never stop dancing. Fabertell, I wish we could have talked more. Cato, I think we could have been great friends. Goanhawe, I am sorry. Make our new home better, better than any home we have ever known. 

We have joined together for something great
And while I have been lost to fate
Stay together, as one we are strong
Stay together, hear my song
Be strong and fight for Roanoke
Thrive, and grow strong like an oak 
I believe in you all, you will survive 
But more than that, you will thrive


For Roanoke, 
Amara Venlar ||

So I had the pleasure of reading the wedding scene while I was waiting in the doctors office (all that waiting for them to just go 🤷‍♀️ and send me home) so some notes:

1) *You guys are all so adorable!!*
2) Might as well use my absence from rp for some character development so here's what's up with Leaf while I wait to get better.

These woods, as far as she can tell, are a lot closer to home than London ever was. That combined with Ebuc and Navar being ~~dead~~ missing, it's unsurprising that she's fallen back into old habits. After being abandoned by her goblin tribe, Leaf spent years wandering by herself along well traveled roads. She'd spend hours watching people from behind trees and bushes, hoping to snag some unattended food or any trinkets left behind. As she learned Common, she told herself she'd try talking to people instead of taking things, but more often than not her fear would get the best of her and she'd just watch instead. 
A similar thing is happening now. Old habits die hard, even in the New World. She likely would have watched tonight's wedding from up in a tree (vibe: zacchaeus) but wouldn't have done anything for fear of ruining things. She's happy for the newlywed couple and all the couple's who've formed in the RTG, but she can't help but feel a bit misplaced. That on top of the grief and guilt, she just doesn't know what to do with herself. Eventually she'll come out of her hidey hole and talk things out, but for now she's got Lilly the rose bush and Melora keeping her safe.

Web continues to have nightmares. They aren't every night and they aren't always so horrible, but those ones do come. The most common, most mundane have to do with the golden dawn. They see the attack on the submarine before it left port, but the bodies fished out of the Thames are their friends, faces staring blankly back. They see the day Rah was killed, but this time they remain feral and eat his body. They see themselves as Solomon, casting the spell that killed him. The darker ones have to do with memory. Their memory being changed by Solomon so far that they  don't remember anything *but* the golden dawn. A version of the past where they were the one encouraging death, not Solomon. The blink bug behind their ear telling them to look away from their friends, abandon them. The worst dreams are the ones involving the Oblex. Forgetting Skitter again. Never being forgiven for forgetting Skitter. Forgetting more and more people important to them until they are nothing. They imagine a fate even worse than death, even worse than premature burial. They dream of knowing they have lost everything important to them, yet also knowing they will never know what those things were.

Cato's relationship with Wren has changed. He will see her more as a partner now, and in return hopes she will trust him more. Together they can be great scouts. <@519566652824616973>

Arc’s greatest fears have started to haunt them again.

Darkness lifts as a dream begins. A scene of peace stretches forth, a lawn full of joy and sun. It’s akin to the wedding just days ago. The sun begins to set, and long shadows engulf the area, reaching out like inky tendrils grasping for the dappled golden light of a fading day.

As the night envelops the field, people start to collapse. First is Note, and Vee, and then Skitter. They drop to the ground, fading into the shadows.

Next is Wynne, and then Wren, and finally, Cato’s eyes drain of life as he falls to Arc’s feet. The landscape is blanketed under a cold, dark mist for a few moments.

In the same order, the bodies float up out of the black cloud. Face up, with their blood evaporating into the night wind, bodies dehydrating and turning to skeletons. 

More bodies than before - all those Arc’s neglected and lead indirectly to the death of. More and more resurface until it’s a pile of dismembered bones. At the very summit, among a vortex of blood and smoke and fire, a throne sits.

It beckons for them. They walk slowly upon the bones of their friends. Arrogantly, they sit.

(Continued in next)

The throne collapses, and sends them falling into a great pit, one of tartaric proportions, and their wings turn to bone.

They pass a prison, lit by roaring flames, punctuated by the sounds of whips and chains. Inside, Wren, and hundreds of other children are screaming and crying, unable to escape. The cages are all stamped with Arc’s signature.

They continue to fall. They pass by the ocean ruin of Mantapolis. Inside are countless bodies, massacred and slaughtered by Arc’s creations. Some have marks of their spells, their guns, their abilities. All are calling out for mercy, even when some have dismembered heads.

They pass by another vision. This time, chains bound them. Around them, faceless humanoids are crowded together. Another form, the form of their father, walks slowly, cutting each throat. *Thud* after *thud*, they drop to the ground. The figure of their father turns to face them, and distorts, forming a mirror image of them. Their chains disappear.

Finally, they hit the bottom. They begin to sink, but they scramble up. They see themself standing at the top of a mountain of gold and bones, and their form is distorted too. 

They’ve been branded again.

*Traitor* is burned into their skin all over, scarred and gruesome. Their horns are longer, and glow like molten metal. Their skin is burnt and charred, and their wings are bright with fire. They look like a devil if there ever was one.

They collapse backwards, beginning to drown in the gold and blood. As they watch, the sky stretches above them, black and starless. Everything returns to the black it started with.
(End)
